Corollary
[Exponential decay of the trace-free Ricci tensor] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0233 1. Corollary 6.69\group exponential-convergence

For a normalized Ricci flow solution on a closed three-manifold of initially positive Ricci curvature, the trace-free Ricci tensor decays exponentially: \[ \left|\Rc -\frac13 Rg\right| \le Be^{-\beta t}. \]
